notes.title: [Update and Bug Fix Notification]
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Kimi ga Nozomu Eien: Enhanced Edition".
We have implemented an update at 19:00 [Wed.] 1/29 JST to address the following issues:

・Fixed an issue where fullscreen mode was not accessible in certain environments.
・Minor fixes including text corrections.

The following issue is scheduled to be fixed in a future update:

・The "RESET" button may not function properly when in fullscreen mode.

We kindly request that you update your application through Steam and restart the game.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
